{{Quote|Iasento was the leader of a Mimbanese tribe before the Clone Wars. He and his people were armed and trained by Republic clone troopers to defend their planet from Separatist invaders.|An entry in an artist's journal restored and expanded by the Graf Archive|<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref>}}
Elder '''Iasento''' was a [[Mimbanese]] [[Iasento's tribe|tribal leader]] who was armed and trained by the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[224th Imperial Armored Division|224th Division]] during the [[Clone Wars]] in order to battle [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Battle of Mimban|invaders]] of his [[homeworld]], [[Mimban]].

Following the end of the [[Clone Wars]], Iasento was forced to continue fighting as leader of the [[Mimbanese Liberation Army]] against a [[Mimban Campaign|pacification campaign]] by the [[Galactic Empire]], which was attempting to strip Mimban of its resources. Iasento was familiar with the Empire's tactics from his Republic training, and had his troops use camouflage in the increasingly muddy battlefields of Mimban. In [[10 BBY]], he was [[Death|killed]] during the fighting by the criminal [[Tobias Beckett]]. 

==Biography==
===War leader===
[[File:Iasento-Databank.png|thumb|300px|left|Iasento (left) was a tribal and military leader of the Mimbanese people.]]
Elder Iasento<ref name="BtCtG">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> was the [[Mimbanese]] leader of a [[Iasento's tribe|tribe]] in the [[Nanth flatlands]] on his [[homeworld]], [[Mimban]], prior to the [[Clone Wars]]. During the wars, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Mimban|invaded]] the [[planet]]<ref name="TOG" /> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> in order to [[Mining|mine]] [[hyperbaride]] minerals. The Mimbanese fought back, allying with the Separatist's foes in the [[Grand Army of the Republic|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="BtCtG" /> Members of the [[224th Imperial Armored Division|224th Division]] of [[clone trooper]]s armed and train Iasento and his people to fight the Separatists, promising them freedom once the invaders were repelled.<ref name="TOG" />

Although the Separatists ultimately lost the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Mimban's heavy mineral deposits were a lucrative resource for the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="BtCtG" /> and it was decreed that the mines continue operation, with Imperial [[Moff]] [[Bin Essada]] demanding that all resources be stripped from Mimban. Iasento and the Mimbanese resisted the Empire's mining efforts as the [[Mimbanese Liberation Army]],<ref name="TOG" /> which Iasento commanded during the [[Mimban Campaign|Imperial pacification campaign]] by the 224th Imperial Armored Division against the natives. The fighting continued for [[Standard decade|decades]], with ground combat turning much of the world into a muddy quagmire.<ref name="BtCtG" />

===Criminal casualty===
In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> a [[Beckett's gang|criminal gang]] led by the outlaw [[Tobias Beckett]] infiltrated the [[Imperial Army]] on Mimban in order to steal an [[Y-45 armored transport hauler]]. While disguised as an Imperial [[captain]], Beckett encountered Iasento near the Imperial [[Imperial Forward Field Operations|Camp Forward]]<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> as the Empires forces were trying to push toward a Mimbanese-controlled ridge.<ref name="BtCtG" />

As Iasento charged alone toward the criminal, Beckett shot the elder in the chest with a [[RSKF-44 heavy blaster]] and [[Death|killed]] him while providing cover for his gang to reach an Imperial trench.<ref name="Solo" /> The Empire would eventually claim victory over the Mimbanese on Mimban.<ref name="BtCtG" /> Iasento was pictured and mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed by the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /> at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Iasento-BTCG.png|thumb|250px|right|Iasento was familiar with Imperial tactics and skilled in guerrilla warfare.]]
Having received Republic training during the Clone Wars, Iasento was familiar with the tactics adopted by the Empire. The Mimbanese began using camouflage to hide themselves on the increasingly muddy battlefields, and Iasento would allow [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] to push forward before utilizing the camouflage to have his forces attack with coordinated aggression from hidden positions and tunnels among the ruins of their villages.<ref name="BtCtG" /> Iasento had [[Color|red]] skin and blue [[eye]]s. He stood 1.9 [[meter]]s (six [[foot]], three inches) tall.<ref name="TOG" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|The Mimbanese are known to be experts in camouflage!|Caption on an image of Iasento in an artist's journal restored and expanded by the Graf Archive|<ref name="Alien Archive" />}}
Iasento wore traditional red [[Clothing|garments]] including a [[Flak vest|flak jacket]]<ref name="TOG" /> and mud-spattered combat fatigues with panels of woven reed [[armor]] hung over it. Patches of dried [[sedge grass]] attached to the outfit<ref name="BtCtG" /> acted as thatch camouflaged in Mimban's spare underbrush.<ref name="TOG" /> The elder wore repurposed Imperial issue [[army]] [[boot]]s<ref name="BtCtG" /> and a variety of [[Republic Era]] equipment including the [[infrared and sonar pulse detector]]s on his cross strapped [[sensor]] headband, the [[Comlink|comms unit]] attached to his left shoulder<ref name="TOG" /> and the combat webbing across his torso. He fought with a modified [[BlasTech Industries|BlasTech]] [[F-78 blaster rifle]] with a [[vibroblade]] attachment.<ref name="BtCtG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Iasento first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TOG" />
